children.title: Cycle 8 · Research Stagnation and Evidence Mismatch

detail.title: Research Stagnation and Evidence Mismatch
detail.summary: Current research is stalled due to exhausted search slots and a lack of relevant source material. The evidence currently assigned to active projects (related to regional government contact information) does not address the research questions for either project. Future work requires substantive domain-specific retrieval to enable notebook synthesis.
